entities.name: Tobiah ben Eliezer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tobiah ben Eliezer was a Talmudist and poet of the 11th century, author of Lekach Tov or Pesikta Zutarta, a midrashic commentary on the Pentateuch and the Five Megillot.
